api.usage: prepared = prepare_capture(...) api.prepare_capture: same envelope initializer and strict input loading as the CLI (sources, trace, binding, loopback URLs, provenance purpose) plus arm in RUN_ARMS, the CLI purpose rule, request_timeout finite > 0, check_binding, tokenizer from local_model_path and check_tokenizer; refusal/failure returned (ready False, status refused/failed), never raised; ready envelope keeps status failed with NOT_RUN_ERROR until capture_replay
api.capture_replay: ClientRefusal raised (envelope untouched) unless ready and unused; caller values recorded in config (non-finite -> null); refusals with zero sends: non-finite inputs or reserve < 0, clock_domain differs, deadline - reserve < offered_start + duration (never truncated), offered_start not in (now, now + 600 s] at entry and again after GET /v1/models; then the unchanged replay with drain_deadline = deadline - cleanup_reserve_s exactly; collected/refused/failed returned; CancelledError/KeyboardInterrupt finalize interrupted in place then re-raise; other BaseException finalize failed then re-raise; rows and summary cover every allocated record whenever records exist
api.write_capture: the CLI capture.json codec (_write_new: sorted keys, indent 1, allow_nan False, exclusive create, fsync); returns sha256 of the written bytes
